consent.title: Commercial use terms
consent.intro: For the agency to present you to brands, we need your consent (LGPD). With it:
consent.item1: the agency can create the public link to your media kit, showing only the fields you choose;
consent.item2: you can appear in the catalog that the agency's brands browse;
consent.item3: your metrics always show as declared, with the date of each figure;
consent.item4: you can revoke at any time: the link goes offline and you leave the catalog immediately.
consent.outdated: The terms were updated. Accept the new version to keep the link and the catalog.
consent.confirmRevoke: Revoke consent? The public kit link stops working and you leave the catalog.
consent.revoked: Consent revoked. The kit link was turned off.
consent.banner: Without your consent, the agency cannot create the kit link or show you in the catalog.
